common.waiting: Nothing to do yet. Watch the main screen and help out.

rulebook.title: Rulebook
rulebook.instruction: Read the rules out loud. The main player can't see them.

duplicates.title: Duplicate scanner
duplicates.instruction: Duplicates are the same household twice. Shout "Seen it!" when a kept ID returns.
duplicates.none: Nothing kept yet. Watch this space.

fixKit.title: Fix kit
fixKit.instruction: Some records can be fixed. Shout the correct fix so the main player picks it.
fixKit.none: No fix needed for this one.

reveal.title: Reveal power
reveal.instruction: Tap to uncover an extra tile on the main phone. Charges are limited!
reveal.none: No charges left. Help by talking instead!

fieldGuide.title: Field guide
fieldGuide.instruction: Describe what each item looks like to help the main player label it.

auditor.title: Auditor
auditor.instruction: Confidence: how sure the AI is. Read each number out loud.

scout.title: Scout map
scout.instruction: Only you see the flooded roads. Guide the main player around them.
scout.none: No floods on this map. All roads are clear.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.instruction: A manifest is a supply list. Tell the main player what each house needs.
manifest.route: No supplies to match here. Call out where each house is.
manifest.none: No supply list for this level.

debugger.title: Debugger
debugger.instruction: You see the failed run step by step. Shout where it went wrong.
debugger.none: No failed run yet. Fingers crossed!

servers.title: Server controls
servers.instruction: Servers run the app. Boost busy ones. Restart crashed ones fast.
servers.none: No server assigned to you. Watch the dashboard.

balancer.title: Balancer and self-healing
balancer.instruction: Set these switches. Balancer shares users across pods (app copies); self-healing restarts crashed ones.

autoscaler.title: Autoscaler
autoscaler.instruction: The autoscaler adds pods (app copies) when busy. Set min, max and busy level.

routing.title: Incident routing
routing.instruction: Incidents (live problems) for your specialisation appear here. Shout them out, then tap to send.
routing.waiting: Waiting for the next incident. Watch the feed!

replay.title: Storm watch
replay.instruction: Watch uptime and cost. Restart crashed pods and roll back bad updates fast.

main.askRulebook: Your team has the rulebook. Ask them to read it out!
main.askGuide: Not sure what something is? Your team has the field guide. Ask!
main.askScout: Your scouts know which roads flood next run and what houses need. Ask!
main.askServers: Your teammates control the server buttons. Call out which server needs help!
main.askIncidents: Each incident goes to the teammate with that specialisation. Call it out, then confirm!
main.askConfig: Your teammates hold the settings. Agree on a plan, then they tap.
main.askServersTutorial: Call out the busiest server. Your teammates tap Boost and Restart.

allHands.text: Major storm: all teams confirm ready!
Big supply drop incoming. Every team, tap Ready!
Night shift starts: all teams check in now!

allHandsUi.call: All hands! Every phone taps Ready within {s} seconds.
allHandsUi.missed: Not everyone tapped in time. Call it out louder!
